entity.summary: Solana-based trading venue combining coin-margined futures, unified account infrastructure, wealth-management products, copy trading, and automated trading strategies.
entity.notes: The current first-party domain and organization remain live, while independently maintained protocol data identifies Bumpin as an operating Solana derivatives and DeFi venue with non-zero TVL. HEI uses hybrid classification because the reviewed public description explicitly positions the product between centralized and decentralized exchange models and detailed custody and matching architecture is not sufficiently established. No exact launch date, legal jurisdiction, predecessor, successor, or terminal lifecycle fact is asserted.
